name: Home Depot Military Discount
description: 10% off up to $400/year on eligible home improvement purchases
fullDescription: Home Depot offers a 10% military discount on eligible in-store and online purchases for active duty, veterans, and military spouses, with a $400 annual maximum.
whatTheyOffer:
- 10% off eligible purchases
- $400 maximum annual discount (resets each calendar year)
- Available in-store and online
- Most appliances excluded; personal use only
- Virtual ID on Home Depot app for easy checkout
howToGetIt:
1. Download The Home Depot app or visit homedepot.com/military
2. Create account and verify military status through SheerID
3. Eligible: active duty, veterans, and spouses (spouses verify with their own account)
4. Scan Virtual ID in the app at the register, or shop online
5. Physical military IDs and DD-214s no longer accepted at register
keywords: Home Depot, military discount, veteran, active duty, 10% off, home improvement, tools, hardware, SheerID
